description: A food delivery person can either have shifts on bikes or scooters. A shift on a bike can deliver 10 orders, takes 5 units of energy, and brings in $50 on tips because it is faster. A shift on a scooter can deliver 7 orders, takes 6 units of energy, and brings in $43 on tips.  The delivery person has available 40 shifts a month and has 230 units of energy and must bring at least 320 orders. He must have at least 5 shifts on a scooter because bikes are harder to get. How many shifts on each type of transportation should the delivery person schedule to maximize tips received?

TotalShifts.definition: Total number of shifts available per month

TotalEnergy.definition: Total units of energy available per month

MinOrders.definition: Minimum number of orders to deliver

MinShiftsScooter.definition: Minimum number of shifts on a scooter

OrdersPerBikeShift.definition: Number of orders delivered per bike shift

EnergyPerBikeShift.definition: Units of energy consumed per bike shift

OrdersPerScooterShift.definition: Number of orders delivered per scooter shift

EnergyPerScooterShift.definition: Units of energy consumed per scooter shift

objective.description: "Maximize the total tips received from bike and scooter shifts"
objective.code:
del.setObjective(
    TipsPerBikeShift * BikeShifts + TipsPerScooterShift * ScooterShifts,
    GRB.MAXIMIZE

constraints.description: The total number of bike shifts and scooter shifts should not exceed the total available shifts per month (BikeShifts + ScooterShifts <= TotalShifts)
The total energy used by bike and scooter shifts should not exceed the total available energy (EnergyPerBikeShift * BikeShifts + EnergyPerScooterShift * ScooterShifts <= TotalEnergy)
The total number of orders delivered by bike and scooter shifts should be at least the minimum required orders (OrdersPerBikeShift * BikeShifts + OrdersPerScooterShift * ScooterShifts >= MinOrders)
The number of scooter shifts should be at least the minimum required (ScooterShifts >= MinShiftsScooter)
The number of bike shifts should be non-negative (BikeShifts >= 0)

BikeShifts.definition: Number of shifts scheduled on a bike per month

ScooterShifts.definition: Number of shifts scheduled on a scooter per month
